source_text: So, I'd say "proposal recurs" is enough for me to accept it, and on that basis we should onboard the 84.  That said, their status should probably move from "proposed" (which until now was a throw-away status) to "accepted" to "attested" (which is a higher level, e.g., they would become attested if they were used in a mission or a WM cascade).  From the Mojira point of view, we could see the "proposed" as dashed edges (like in the old Diagram drawing) or I guess "faintly-coloured" nodes since in Mojira patterns are shown as nodes rather than edges.  This allows the local cascade to make sense, while the global cascade / GCC should retain those as *proposed* rather than *accepted*.  🈸: I don't need to review them, go ahead.
reply_text:
The library already carries an `@status` line, so "accepted" fits there. Checking how much the recurring proposals vary between their versions before deciding how to write them.The format is clear. Writing the onboarding as a script so it can be rerun as more proposals recur.Only 18 would be written, not 84. My count of "84 recurring" counted proposals, not turns, so it included ids proposed twice within a single turn. Checking that.Only 1 of the 84 is a within-turn repeat; 83 do recur across turns. So the script's 18 comes from somewhere else. Checking the file names it globs.Two naming conventions exist: older records use `turn-X.candidates.json`, newer ones `turn-X.json.candidates.json`. The script only globbed the newer. Fixing it to read both.Now 81 would be written; 2 are skipped because none of their proposals has all four parts. Writing them, then checking that each one parses with the library reader the square emitter uses.All 81 parse into four parts; 7 carry the "worded N ways" flag. Committing to futon3, explicit paths only, then the script.㊥ ("go ahead") Done: 81 of the recurring proposals are now in the futon3 library as `@status accepted` (futon3 `a59c721`). The remaining 3 of the 84 couldn't go in. Two never had a proposal with all four parts. The third was proposed twice in one turn and never again, so it doesn't recur; my earlier "proposed again on later turns" was wrong for that one. The status ladder is in E-gcc-schema §16 as item 14 (futon4 `7cc5cbd`).

㊢ (what went in, and how)
- **Families.** 67 of the 81 are `operator/…`. The rest are single files in agency, aif, apparatus, cascade-construction and a few other families.
- **Each file's text** is 象's most common wording of its five parts, unedited.
- **Each file's status line** gives the number of turns it was proposed for. Example: `name-the-done-signal-act`, 22 turns. The line also says "attested once used in a mission or a War Machine cascade".
- **Each file's provenance line** lists the turn records.
- **Flagged.** Seven files are marked because their THEN was worded four or more different ways. A recurring name may be covering more than one idea in those seven.
- **Checks.** All 81 parse into four non-empty parts with the reader that the square emitter uses. Commits used explicit paths. futon3's other untracked files were left alone.
- **The script** is futon3c `2167ec981`, so the next batch is a rerun.

㊩ (caught on the way) The first dry run would have written 18 files, not 81. 象's candidate files come under two names (`turn-X.candidates.json`, older; `turn-X.json.candidates.json`, newer), and the script only read the newer. It now reads both. The same split may hide records from any other reader of that directory. Worth a check.

㊟ (not yet live) 驴 and the embedding retrieval read an index of the library. They won't propose these 81 until the index is rebuilt, so the first visible effect will come after the next reindex.

🈖 (item 14, in short)
- **The ladder.** Proposed, then accepted (it recurs), then attested (used in a mission or a War Machine cascade).
- **Local and global.** A local cascade may use a proposed pattern so the turn makes sense, while the GCC keeps it as proposed.
- **Mojira.** A proposed pattern is drawn faintly. I've recorded that, but not sent it to claude-cs yet: the one cascade on screen uses library patterns only, so there is nothing faint to show until a turn with a proposed pattern is read.

🈸 (next) Shall I ask for the library reindex now, so 驴 can start retrieving the 81?
